3 अग
 (a-ga) m. a letter other than g एति संज्ञायामगात् P. viii. 3. 99.

4 अग
 (a-ga) m. (a suffix) other than (those denoted by) ga (= Ārdhadhātuka suffixes) न धुखेऽगे JaineVyā. i. 1. 18; i. 4. 109; ii. 1. 27; iv. 4. 48; v. 2. 81; v. 2. 151; (मिङ्शिद्गः JaineVyā. ii. 4. 93) शेषोऽग एव Jaine- Vyā. ii. 4. 94.
